'''XoXaan's tomb''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] mausoleum located on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], within [[XoXaan's Temple]]. It was the [[Burial/Legends|burial]] chamber of [[XoXaan]], [[Exiles|one]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] that conquered Korriban and became the first of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], alongside her piers [[Ajunta Pall]], [[Sorzus Syn]] and many others. The tomb was discovered in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] by then-[[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], who heard the voice of XoXaan calling to his inner [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darkness]]. Hett entered the tomb, wherein he found [[XoXaan's holocron]], from which he learned the ways of the Sith; when he left, he was a new man&mdash;[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="leg17" />
